eps_note: one question is 1/17 = 0.0588 of the score; eps is half of that

directives.EXPLOIT: Answer or fix one more question with the current approach.
directives.BOREDOM_SNAP: Change method for the unanswered questions; look up the exact statistical procedure (Exa) and check past.dev for what failed.
directives.PARADIGM_BREAKOUT: Re-read the questions and data dictionary from scratch; switch analysis library or model family.
directives.CONVERGED: Re-run the analysis to confirm answers are stable.
